A partner brings buyers with a code - ty: A partner brings buyers with a code - typed into the store, or carried by a QR code and a link - and earns a share of each sale made with it. Two tiers and no more: a partner recruited by another names them, and the recruiter earns a recruit share of the recruit's sales; nobody above the recruiter earns from them. A discount code without a partner takes something off the price. The catalog carries the codes and what they take off; the shares stay here. Until the payment service reports sales, they are recorded below by hand.
